articles.title: EDM Dimple
articles.summary: Hex-packed spherical craters with bright rims and dark pits; strong metallic roughness, machined sparkle. A soft, even bubbly sheen; the dimples blur together into a satin-textured shimmer.
articles.what: EDM dimple texture — hex-packed spherical craters, bright rim, dark pit — electrical discharge machining, G=Roughness + R=Metallic Up close: A tight hex-packed lattice of tiny round bumps, about 10 px apart, giving a soft honeycomb or golf-ball dimple sheen with no hard edges. Glows evenly in the highlight band; a touch crisper and brighter on metallic. From a distance: A soft, even bubbly sheen; the dimples blur together into a satin-textured shimmer. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: the channels set by its defaults. Group: Precision & Guilloché (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Legacy collection tab and the group "Precision & Guilloché", or search for "EDM Dimple".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof, sides and bumpers: uniform dimples read across big areas
Good on trim for a machined look
Light texture; numbers stay readable.
A pleasant soft beaded glow in the highlight, mild but visible
Pairs well with: metallic, chrome, satin.
pitfalls: Not a hex paint pattern: it adds no outlines or colours
Not hammered metal: dimples are uniform, small and packed in a perfect lattice
Avoid: matte flat, soft fabric looks.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.goal: Layer EDM Dimple over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.

articles.title: Guilloché Moiré
articles.summary: Offset concentric rings beating into flowing moire ellipses; broad metallic interference, high coverage. Reads as a smooth sheen with a fine crosshatched or fabric-like shimmer; the star tiles are not resolved.
articles.what: Two offset concentric ring systems beating into flowing moiré ellipses, R=Metallic Up close: A fine interlocking pinwheel or kaleidoscope grain, tiny three-armed star shapes tiled edge to edge at roughly 15-20 px, low contrast. It reads as a woven moire shimmer inside the highlight, with the same grain visible on both halves. articles.what: Engine-turned sunray — radial lines + concentric rings polar cross-hatch, pocket-watch dial character, R=Metallic Up close: Nearly smooth with a fine pixel-level crosshatch speckle, sparse bright crystals in the highlight. articles.title: Knurl Diamond
